about: Spec 015 T006 answer key (E22). Icon Precomp (practice project id 111, 400 x 400, 30 fps, 8 s): Icon Shape Position keys at 0 s (x 100, 'left') and 1 s (x 300, 'right'). Four layers of it in a test comp 'T006 time mapping' (30 fps, 8 s), planted by mentor/dev/live-015/time-mapping.jsx on AE 27.0x78, 2026-11-14. 'outer' is the formula the precomp read uses; 'ae_source_time' is AE's sourceTime() expression at that outer time; 'builder' is the builder's scrub check by eye.
